channel.title: Github-Actions on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Github-Actions on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: github: GitHub Actions: macOS 14 runner image retirement
item.description:
GitHub Actions will retire the macOS 14 runner image on November 2, 2026. Before removal, jobs that use macOS 14 will temporarily fail during scheduled awareness periods.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Actions retention now covers checks, runs, and statuses
item.description:
GitHub Actions retention now applies to checks, workflow runs, and statuses, using the same retention setting that already controls artifacts and logs. This means those records are now kept or removed according to the repository or organization Actions retention policy.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code coverage uploads no longer fail CI for new branches
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality’s upload-code-coverage action no longer causes CI failures when coverage is uploaded from a branch that does not yet have an open pull request. This changes behavior from the previous failure case for new branches.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Repository custom runner settings for Dependabot
item.description:
Repository administrators can now set the runner type, optional custom label, and optional runner group for Dependabot version and security updates. This extends existing runner configuration options for Dependabot.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Self-hosted runner version enforcement date has moved
item.description:
GitHub has moved the enforcement date for minimum version requirements on self-hosted runners in GitHub Actions for GitHub Enterprise Cloud. The change ships on Monday, September 28, 2026, with full enforcement starting after that date.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Changes to query results in the GitHub Actions API and UI
item.description:
GitHub Actions workflow run queries in the API and UI now return a less precise but more accurate total count for search results across filters like workflow, event, status, and branch.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions
item.description:
GitHub Actions runners no longer include Node 20. JavaScript actions now run on Node 24, and the temporary ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION opt-out is no longer available.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Ubuntu 26 generally available and latest migration
item.description:
Ubuntu 26.04 runner images for GitHub Actions are now generally available and fully supported for production workflows on x64 and arm64. The release notes also mention a migration update.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Workflow execution protections in GitHub Actions generally available
item.description:
Workflow execution protections in GitHub Actions are now generally available for GitHub Enterprise, organizations, and repositories. The feature lets you define an allowlist to control who can execute workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Control GitHub Actions cache access with cache-mode
item.description:
GitHub Actions now supports cache-mode to control cache access at the workflow or job level. This lets you grant least-privilege cache access instead of broad cache permissions.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Xcode 27 runner image now runs on macOS 27
item.description:
GitHub’s Xcode 27 runner image for GitHub-hosted macOS runners now runs on macOS 27 and is available in public preview. This lets you validate Apple apps against macOS 27 using that runner image.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Actions: Early September 2026 updates
item.description:
GitHub Actions added three updates focused on workflow visibility and control. The post highlights a new REST API for runner version deprecations, but the provided excerpt does not include the full details of the other changes.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.4 improves GitHub actions security detections
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.4 is a new release that adds support for Go 1.27 and improves GitHub Actions security detections. It is part of the static analysis engine used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Actions retention will cover checks, workflow runs, and statuses
item.description:
Starting October 1, 2026, GitHub Actions retention settings will also apply to checks, workflow runs, and statuses, in addition to artifacts and logs. These data types will follow the same retention policy going forward.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Windows 11 arm64 VS2026 image generally available
item.description:
Windows 11 arm64 images with Visual Studio 2026 are now generally available on standard and larger GitHub-hosted runners. Workflows can use the new image by updating the runner image reference.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Separate GitHub Actions path for GitHub Code Quality
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality CodeQL Actions workflows now have a dedicated workflow path and are generally available. Run history and Actions usage reports can now distinguish GitHub Code Quality runs from other Actions workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves GitHub Actions queries and JavaScript modeling
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.3 adds source modeling for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue, and updates several GitHub Actions queries for better accuracy. It is a CodeQL release used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: dotnet: Test reporting in Microsoft.Testing.Platform: from red build to root cause
item.description:
Microsoft.Testing.Platform adds test reporting that surfaces failures in GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps, uses pipeline history to distinguish regressions from flaky tests, and keeps reports usable even if the test host crashes.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: Reference same-repository actions with self-repository syntax
item.description:
GitHub added a new self-repository syntax for uses: so actions and reusable workflows in the same repository can be referenced with a $/-prefixed value. This changes how same-repo workflows/actions are addressed, but the provided text does not include further details.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Actions holds potentially malicious workflows for approval
item.description:
GitHub Actions now detects potentially malicious workflow changes in public repositories and requires approval before they run. The change is intended to reduce supply-chain abuse from compromised credentials used to add workflows that steal CI/CD secrets or perform follow-on attacks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Mobile: Fix failing Actions checks with Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Mobile now lets you ask Copilot coding agent to investigate and fix failing GitHub Actions checks on a pull request directly from the mobile app. The feature starts from a failed check and uses Copilot cloud agent to work on the issue.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Xcode 27 runner image now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub-hosted macOS runners now support Xcode 27 in public preview, letting you build and test Apple apps against the latest Xcode version. This is an early-access runner image release.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: setup-java v5.5.0: signature verification, Kona JDK, and Maven fixes
item.description:
setup-java v5.5.0 adds cryptographic signature verification for downloaded JDKs, support for Kona JDK, and several Maven-related fixes. It is the release over v5.4.0.

  • Source: GitHub
